kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

lines.say: End the day thankful. Here's why.
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
lines.big: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

lines.say: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; Psalm one three, verses two and three.
lines.big: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

lines.say: Count what he did today before you count what went wrong.
lines.big: Count what he did today before you count what went wrong.

lines.say: Lord, I won't forget your benefits. Thank you for today. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 79 through 104, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
